svg.title: For the second limit the principal term is (Ak(1/5)/βk) Lease(Pk) →0 by TS1; the other term is its paid divergence error. Before transport this is β−1 k times the orbit of Xk −βkZk, an exact served equation insertion by the finite local divergence identity. Logarithmic insertion comparison gives common coefficient/function limits; core projection commutes with orbit and coordinate change is linear. Thus TS2 is exactly this normalized transformed limit. The retained equation estimate gives bβp kisi(vki) →0 for every integer p ≥0. (TS4)
